comments.author: Jafar
comments.body:
Claudia's point might make sense, but only for NPC sold items like this one. As dungeonners flow money into the game, NPC sold objects become easier to buy.

But of course, quest objects do not follow that law because you need someone to effectively take the hassle to do the quest, so if you can get twice more money dungeoning than before, adventurers will ask for twice more money for the quest items.

comments.author: liuyifei
comments.body:
does putting more than 1 of this in your farm useful or useless > ?

does this ( and any other farm tools ) help with your development only (faster dev ) or it has other use like more product gain or easier to get rare set product ?

comments.author: Yaknow
comments.body: From my experience, if your farm does not have the corresponding item for mines or farms or ranch or w/e, the development level will decline a little bit every day.

comments.author: Visitor
comments.body:
Indeed. Additionally, I was taught that having extra of a certain farm tool helped raise the development points gained from upgrades in the appropriate category, such as candles for mining development. The higher grade farm tools which give more points to their respective categories do seem to support this.

As well, 'Rare product sets' tend to rely more on reaching a certain level of development before you have any chance of trying to acquire them.

comments.author: liuyifei
comments.body: okay so now i know this help with the development but is it have advantage if i stock 2 or 3 candles at once to boost mining or is useless ?

comments.author: Visitor
comments.body: The higher your development in mines, the greater the yield of trade goods from your farm. The highest development for each category is 1000.

comments.author: liuyifei
comments.body: thx but it still doesn't answer my question , does putting 2 or more of the same farm tools are usefull ? or i should put 1 of each type ?

comments.author: Wystein
comments.body: You can't put two tools of the same type in. There is only 1 tool slot for each farm area.
